description: This Java source file defines the ThingDeletedStrategy class, which handles the ThingDeleted event by updating the lifecycle state of a 'Thing' to DELETED within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and is part of the persistence actor strategies in the system.

classes.name: ThingDeletedStrategy
classes.description: Final class that handles handling of the ThingDeleted event by setting the lifecycle state of a 'Thing' to DELETED.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process a ThingDeleted event by setting the lifecycle of the thing to DELETED.
